pairs.evidence: src/app/api/org/memory/reflect/route.ts:124 A failed origin lookup becomes an empty member list, so the registry-origin refusal passes without having checked anything and applyReflection, which selects no origin, supersedes mirror rows the next index pass will revert.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/org/memory/reflect/route.ts:124 Could-not-check is folded into clean with no operator signal, the failure the technique names for an in-path gate; beside the work it should refuse. route.test.ts covers the refusal but no lookup rejection.

src/app/api/org/memory/route.ts:109 getCreditState is caught to null at line 107 and a missing plan resolves to free, so on a read failure a paying Team org is told it needs the plan it already has. The check and reflect routes repeat this.
src/features/shared/memory/memoryCheck.ts:52 The duplicate check is labelled advisory and is advisory by construction: POST /api/org/memory never reads its verdict.
src/lib/memory/consolidation.ts:314 A word-overlap and LLM detector with unmeasured precision has not earned blocking, and the contract keeps it from refusing correct content.

src/features/shared/memory/MemoryCheckView.tsx:33 The verdict shows the population actually compared and whether a model judged it, so 'This looks new' over zero candidates cannot pass as a full check.
